analysis.title: US Market Intelligence - Afternoon Briefing - Oct 5
key_insights: US stocks closed higher led by Tech: SPX +0.7%, NDX +0.9%, RTY +0.5%, with nearly 65% of stocks up and 10 of 11 sectors green. The desk saw both long buying and short covering, and its Potential Squeeze basket (JPSQZZ) beat the SPX by 13bp.
Thematically, Stagflation/Rates Sensitives led while Beta/Momentum lagged. Software beat Semis, Growth beat Value, and Defensives beat Cyclicals.

JPM Econ says the final September services PMI business activity index was revised to 58.8 from 58.7 flash, the highest since July 2021. New orders growth is at a four-and-a-half year high and input cost inflation is the fastest since November 2022.

The ISM services index fell to 54.9 from 55.4 in August. New orders were 59.8 and prices paid rose to 74.0, the highest since July 2022. ISM employment returned to expansion at 50.1 after two months below 50.

Market Intel says Prices Paid has been above 70 for 6 of the last 7 months and tends to lead CPI by 2-3 months, so the inflation impulse remains a key market risk. It reads the print as supportive of its Tactically Bullish view.

Market Intel says higher bond yields mean Tech concentration likely continues. Cyclicals need yields to stabilize or move slightly lower to get going fully, and it flags Financials as lightly positioned.
Fed: recent dovish Fedspeak cut October hike odds from about 70% a week ago to about 26%. There are 7 Fed speakers this week plus the FOMC Minutes on Wednesday.

TMT desk (Heavey): third-party research firm Cleveland says agentic transactions were 2x in September, supporting META and SHOP. Muse 'disruption' names BKNG and EXPE continue to struggle. The PTC deal is lifting the 'AI Vulnerable' baskets and Construction SW names ADSK and PCOR, while CRM is lagging.
TMT desk (Heavey): flows are very quiet to start the week, with profit-taking in Hardware after Friday's rally.

TMT desk (Meyers): Gokul Hariharan expects TSM to build a second fab cluster in Texas (ramping 2030+), as a foundry or a JV with dedicated capacity for TSLA/SPCX, and does not expect a Terafab deal beyond possible investments. He sees reduced competition supporting a higher TSM multiple and a positive read for GUC.

MRVL hosts its Investor Day Oct 6 at 9am ET. Harlan Sur expects a long-term framework through C30 with data center TAM CAGR of 20-25% or higher, operating margin in the low/mid-40% range, and C30 earnings power above $20. He models $12.5b AI custom ASIC and $13.5b optical interconnect for about C28.

JPM upgraded Brazil back to Overweight after the first-round election results. It expects MSCI Brazil to gain 12% near term and 20% beyond, citing BRL strength, more Selic cuts (a November move is live) and a re-rating from 8.9x forward PE toward 10.9x.

Delta-One (Sinha): the Stagflation factor is rising almost vertically, similar to 2022. Credit spreads have widened only modestly, growth surprises have rolled over since June, and weakness in residual volatility is an early warning for beta.

Market Intel Tactically Bullish rationale: October hike odds fell from 64% to 22% and the 2Y moved from 4.85% to 4.82%. The market prices about 1 hike in 2026 and 2 in 2027. Q3 earnings growth is expected near 29% after +52% in Q2.

Monetization Menu (unchanged from Sep 28): Tech as core long without the RTY short pair, using derivatives to play squeeze risk. It favors Semis and Mag 7 within Tech, and Banks ex-AI. A US/Iran deal is the biggest upside catalyst and would squeeze EU and RTY higher.
Catalysts: CPI Oct 14, Fed Oct 28, FOMC Minutes Oct 7, MRVL Investor Day Oct 6, PEP Oct 8 and DAL Oct 9 earnings, Brazil runoff Oct 25, trade truce expiry Nov 1, US midterms Nov 3.

earnings_insights: Market consensus: Q3 2026 S&P earnings growth of about 29% (consensus est) after +52% printed in Q2 2026. JPM says the estimate may prove light, since all 11 sectors are expected to show positive revenue and EPS growth.
MRVL management is expected to give a C30 EPS power above $20 at its Oct 6 Investor Day (Harlan Sur est), though the desk hears some investors expect only an F30 guide.
DAL and PEP kick off earnings season, with PEP on Oct 8 and DAL on Oct 9. Earnings Oct 6: AEHR, BRUN, LW, NEOG, STZ. Oct 7: APLD.

risk_factors: Inflation impulse from ISM prices paid at 74.0, with tariffs and fuel costs the most cited issues.
Rising bond yields and market concentration around Tech.
The Stagflation factor is rising almost vertically as in 2022, and correlated moves in the dollar, rates and credit could be a headwind for high-flying tech.
French sovereign credit risk and bond contagion.
Weak labor data (NFP downside surprise) versus survey data pointing to stronger employment.
Squeeze risk from a move lower in oil or yields.
charts_described: ISM-Services Prices Paid vs CPI (3-month lagged) is shown, but the text gives no chart specifics beyond the 2-3 month lead.
vol_and_positioning: The Potential Squeeze basket (JPSQZZ) outperformed the SPX by 13bp, and the desk saw both long buying and short covering.
Financials positioning is light. JPM flagged long C, MS, PNC, FITB, CFG, BNY and short WFC, TFC, RF, BAC, HBAN (Rob O'Dwyer).
The Residual Volatility factor (JPRVPURE) is weakening and is an early warning that usually shows up in beta (JPBPURE) with a lag.
Lower rate volatility is typically supportive of equities, especially long-duration growth.
Squeeze risk from a move lower in oil or yields argues for using derivatives rather than an RTY short.
geopolitical: A US/Iran deal is flagged as the biggest upside catalyst and would squeeze EU and RTY higher.
French sovereign credit risk made France the notable European laggard.
The Trump-Xi one-year trade truce expires Nov 1. One calendar item says it was extended to Jan 20, 2027.
Brazil election: first-round results prompted the upgrade, with the runoff on Oct 25.
The Israel legislative election is on Oct 27, and the Spanish election outlook lifted Spain's equities.

tension_points.bull_case: JPM Market Intel is Tactically Bullish. Macro is strong, ISM is in expansion for 22 months, yields have stabilized, October hike odds fell to about 22%, and Q3 earnings growth of about 29% may prove light.
tension_points.bear_case: Delta-One says the Stagflation factor is rising almost vertically like 2022, growth surprises have rolled over since June, and ISM prices paid at 74.0 leads CPI by 2-3 months. Correlated moves in the dollar, rates and credit could weigh on high-flying tech.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A rise in bond yields without stabilization, or an unexpected rise in inflation or inflation expectations; the CPI and PPI prints next week are key.
